record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.original_question: For a Riemannian foliation on a compact manifold, what precise connections relate dynamical properties of the transverse geodesic flow to the asymptotic behavior of eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the corresponding Laplacian in the adiabatic limit?

evidence.quote: In Section 3.4, we have seen that adiabatic limits for the spectrum of the Laplace operator on a Riemannian foliated manifold can be naturally considered as semiclassical spectral problems on the leaf space of the foliation. Therefore, the following problem is quite natural and its solution would provide a natural generalization of the results mentioned above to this setting.

Problem 4.9. To relate dynamical properties of the transverse geodesic flow of a Riemannian foliation on a compact manifold and asymptotic properties of the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the corresponding Laplacian in the adiabatic limit.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold equipped with a Riemannian foliation $\mathcal{F}$, that is, a foliation admitting a bundle-like metric $g$ so that the induced metric on the normal bundle $N\mathcal{F}$ is holonomy-invariant. Split the metric as $g = g_F \oplus g_H$, where $g_F$ is the leafwise component and $g_H$ is the transverse component, and consider the one-parameter family of rescaled bundle-like metrics
$$g_\varepsilon = g_F + \varepsilon^{-2}\, g_H, \qquad \varepsilon \to 0^+ \text{ (adiabatic limit)}.$$
Let $\Delta_\varepsilon$ denote the Laplace–Beltrami operator of $g_\varepsilon$ acting on $C^\infty(M)$, with eigenvalues $\{\lambda_j(\varepsilon)\}_{j\geq 0}$ and an orthonormal eigenbasis $\{\varphi_{j,\varepsilon}\}$.

On the transverse side, let $\pi: N^*\mathcal{F} \to M$ be the conormal bundle of $\mathcal{F}$ and let $\Phi_t$ be the transverse geodesic flow on $N^*\mathcal{F}$, i.e. the Hamiltonian flow on the leaf space (in the holonomy groupoid sense) associated with the transverse principal symbol of $\Delta_\varepsilon$ in the adiabatic limit.

Problem. Establish precise correspondences between the dynamical properties of the transverse geodesic flow $\Phi_t$ (such as ergodicity, mixing, or hyperbolicity with respect to the transverse Liouville measure) and the semiclassical asymptotic behavior, as $\varepsilon \to 0^+$, of the eigenvalues $\lambda_j(\varepsilon)$ and of the microlocal lifts of the eigenfunctions $\varphi_{j,\varepsilon}$ in suitable spectral windows. In particular, formulate and prove an analogue of the Shnirelman–Zelditch–Colin de Verdière quantum ergodicity theorem in this adiabatic-limit setting for Riemannian foliations.
artifact.status_search_result: No published result establishes a full quantum ergodicity theorem in the adiabatic limit for general Riemannian foliations relating transverse geodesic flow dynamics to eigenvalue/eigenfunction asymptotics of the Laplacian. Related work exists on adiabatic spectral asymptotics for Riemannian foliations and on quantum ergodicity in sub-Riemannian (e.g. contact 3D) settings, but the foliation analogue is stated as an open problem and no resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Adiabatic limits and spectral sequences for Riemannian foliations
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral asymptotics of the Laplacian is studied when the metric on the ambient manifold is blown up in directions normal to the leaves (adiabatic limit).
status_evidence.claim: Adiabatic-limit spectral results are known but do not address transverse dynamics ↔ eigenfunctions.

status_evidence.title: Quantum ergodicity for sub-Riemannian Laplacians
status_evidence.snippet: Quantum ergodicity proved in sub-Riemannian (contact 3D) setting.
status_evidence.claim: Quantum ergodicity has been extended to related degenerate geometric settings, but not to Riemannian foliations in the adiabatic limit.

status_evidence.title: Quantum ergodicity - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Shnirelman–Zelditch–Colin de Verdière theorem for compact Riemannian manifolds with ergodic geodesic flow.
status_evidence.claim: Classical statement that the foliation problem aims to generalize.
